exceptions.customer_experience: Payment pending then expires; money returns to account

exceptions.trigger: Wrong recipient / authorized push payment scam
exceptions.customer_experience: Customer must phone 800-655-2265 ('I believe I've been a victim of a scam. Who should I contact? Please contact our customer support team'); no in-app scam report, no scam interstitial documented at send time, and no purchase protection from Capital One or Zelle. Help center provides 'Common scam types' education only.
exceptions.bank_handling: Case-by-case; no published reimbursement commitment for scams
exceptions.resolution: No Capital One-published scam reimbursement commitment and no purchase protection; victims must phone 800-655-2265. Zelle network rules (since 30 June 2023) provide recovery/refund for qualifying imposter scams (government, bank or provider impersonation), assessed case by case; other authorized-payment scams generally not reimbursed.

exceptions.customer_experience: Report by phone (800-655-2265) or in writing
exceptions.bank_handling: Reg E investigation 10/45/90 days; provisional credit
exceptions.resolution: $0 liability if reported within 2 business days; up to $500 / full loss tiers thereafter

assessment: Clean account-scoped flow with QR and contact pick; OTP step-up on send. Gaps vs peers: no split, no documented scam interstitial, no in-app scam/dispute reporting, enrollment only in app, and the 2025 Zelle terms expressly exclude business use.

terms.limits: Dynamic; converted Discover 360 Checking shows $3,000/day, $12,500/month (press). Request has no limit.
terms.cutoffs: Minutes for enrolled recipients; scheduled Zelle cancel by 11:59 PM ET day before
